exclude.description: Files to skip, as gitignore patterns. Adds to the list below.

front-matter.description: The front matter keys whose strings are checked, as dotted paths from the top level, such as `params.summary`. Replaces the list below; `[]` checks no front matter. By default: title, subtitle, description, summary, abstract and excerpt.

output.description: How issues are printed when `--output` doesn't say.

oneOf.description: Issues grouped under each file, numbered
One issue per line: path:line:col: [n] "match" -> message (rule)
A Markdown report with each issue's line, suggestions and explanation
Checkstyle XML, for reviewdog, Jenkins and other CI tools

OverrideTable.description: One `[[overrides]]` entry: settings for some files only.

accept.description: Matches no rule reports in these files.

paths.description: Gitignore patterns for the files this applies to.

accept.description: Its matches not to report, compared whole and in any case.

Source.description: `"default"` for the built-in rules, a directory of rule files, or `{ path, prefix }`. A project config's paths are relative to the project root; any other config's, to its directory.

SourceTable.description: A rule directory with an id prefix of its own.

prefix.description: The first part of its rules' ids. By default, the directory's name.

description: A proserunner config file: the user's (`~/.config/proserunner/config.toml`), a project's (`.proserunner/config.toml`), or one given with `--config`. Each layers over the one before; `proserunner config` shows the result.

accept.description: Matches no rule reports, compared whole and in any case. Adds to the list below.

extends.description: Configs this one builds on, such as a team's shared style. Each is a layer just below this one, in order, so this file's settings win over theirs, and their `rules` come before this file's own. Paths are relative to the project root in a project config, and to this file's directory in any other.

fail-on.description: The least serious level that makes a run exit 1.

formats.description: The format of files a path pattern matches, such as `"*.qmd" = "markdown"`, for files whose extension says nothing or the wrong thing. Adds to the rows below; the last row that matches a file wins.

inherit.description: `false` leaves out the configs below this one, and their ignore lists. The configs this one extends stay.

mask.description: Regular expressions for text no rule should see, such as template syntax. Adds to the list below.

overrides.description: Settings for the files that match `paths`. They apply in order, so a later one wins.

rule.description: Settings for one rule, by id: `[rule."default/hedging"]`.

rules.description: Where rules come from: `"default"` for the built-in rules, or directories of rule files. Replaces the list below, except the lists of configs this one extends, which it adds to.

title: proserunner config
